title: Recurrence types 5 years after endovenous thermal ablation of the insufficient small saphenous vein considering the reflux- and junction types
summary: Follow-up examination of 500 legs after laser-treatment of incompetent small saphenous vein.
conditions: Varicose veins of lower extremities without ulcer or inflammation

interventions.name: This prospective cohort study is designed to enroll the 500 patients with saphenopopliteal junction (SPJ) insufficiency who underwent endoluminal varicose vein laser-treatment for the first time between August 2019 and February 2023 and were exhaustively examined.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with insufficiency of the small saphenous vein, if applicable their cranial extension or Giacomini vein, who were comprehensively examined sonographically (including determination of reflux and junction types) and underwent endovenous laser ablation for the first time between August 2019 and February 2023.
Exclusion criteria:
Recurrent varicosis of the small saphenous vein, simultaneous treatment of other veins on the same extremity. Aplasia or only rudimentary saphenopopliteal junction.
